subject: EVC validator hardening against Wave 13 evidence integrity defects

rules_added.title: Bundled IV must be IV_PASS or have a documented later IV_PASS repair
rules_added.prevents: W13-CONTRA-01: bundle contained IV_FAIL pre-closeout snapshot

rules_added.title: Bundle must contain final/sprint-closeout.json or external-proof manifest
Adversarial review must not be PRE_CLOSEOUT only when SPRINT_COMPLETE claimed
rules_added.prevents: W13-CONTRA-03: only PRE_CLOSEOUT adversarial review present

rules_added.title: IV verdict must agree with sprint verdict
rules_added.prevents: W13-CONTRA-04: taskcard claimed IV PASS while bundled IV showed IV_FAIL

rules_added.title: PRE_CLOSEOUT adversarial review requires accompanying final review
rules_added.prevents: pre-closeout review that explicitly says 'final verification required' cannot be sole review

rules_added.title: Sidecar path referenced in closeout must be verified by BMV-06
rules_added.prevents: closeout references sidecar that was not yet created at review time

rules_added.title: Actual bundle entry count must match closeout record
rules_added.prevents: stale bundle with different entry count than closeout records

rules_added.title: Sprint verdict must be consistent across closeout, lane-ledger, and IV result
rules_added.prevents: SPRINT_COMPLETE claim while lane-ledger or IV disagree

regression_fixtures.name: test_wave13_contradiction_scenario
regression_fixtures.description: Exact Wave 13 defect state (IV_FAIL bundled, missing closeout, PRE_CLOSEOUT adversarial) — must FAIL EVC

regression_fixtures.name: test_wave13_with_repair_addendum_passes
regression_fixtures.description: Wave 14 repair scenario (IV_FAIL overridden by addendum, final adversarial review present) — must PASS EVC
